name: Cartographer
ability: You start knowing how many seats away the nearest evil player is.
flavor: Every coast is the same coast. Only the rocks move.
firstNightReminder: Show the Cartographer a number of fingers: the number of seats from them to the nearest evil player (a neighbour is 1; take the shorter direction). Skip the Stowaway's seat.

name: Lighthouse Keeper
ability: Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight. The next day, all players learn who you chose.
flavor: Some nights the light is a warning. Some nights it is a promise. The sea has never learned the difference.
otherNightReminder: The Lighthouse Keeper points to a player. Apply any Wrecker redirect. Mark that player SAFE. At dawn, publicly announce who the light fell on.

jinxes.reason: If the Lighthouse Keeper protects the Pukka's previously poisoned player, that player does not die and becomes healthy.
A player made safe by the Lighthouse Keeper cannot be converted by the Siren; the Siren's first conversion is not used up.
The dawn announcement names the player the light actually fell on, after any Wrecker redirect.

name: Harbourmaster
ability: Once per game, during the day, publicly close the harbour: nobody dies tonight.
flavor: Chain across the mouth of the bay. Nothing in, nothing out, nothing lost.

jinxes.reason: If the harbour is closed, the Siren's ability does nothing tonight: nobody dies and nobody is converted. The Siren's first conversion remains available.
If the harbour is closed, the Pukka's previously poisoned player does not die and becomes healthy. The Pukka still poisons a new player.

name: Pearl Diver
ability: Each night*, choose a player who died at night: you learn their character.
flavor: The sea keeps what it takes. She goes down and takes it back.
otherNightReminder: The Pearl Diver points to a player who died at night (never an executed player). Apply any Wrecker redirect only if the other marked player also died at night. Show that player's character token.

jinxes.reason: The Wrecker only redirects the Pearl Diver's choice if the other marked player is also a player who died at night.

name: Navigator
ability: Once per game, at night*, choose 2 players: you learn how many alive evil players sit between them, clockwise from the 1st.
flavor: Two stars, and the stretch of dark between them.
otherNightReminder: If the Navigator has not used their ability, they may point to 2 players. Apply any Wrecker redirect. Walk clockwise from the 1st to the 2nd, count alive evil players strictly between them, skipping the Stowaway's seat. Show that number. Mark NO ABILITY.

name: Ferryman
ability: If you die, choose another dead player: if they are good, they are resurrected tonight.
flavor: One coin, one crossing. No refunds. Exchanges considered.
otherNightReminder: If the Ferryman died tonight or was executed today and has not yet chosen, wake them: they point to another dead player, never themself. If nobody else is dead, there is no crossing. Apply ordinary legal Wrecker swaps to a good Ferryman's night choice. Exception: if both the chosen other dead player and the dead Ferryman are Wrecked, redirect a good Ferryman's night choice to the Ferryman themself; the original choice can be good or evil. Never redirect a day choice. After any redirect, if the final target is good (and the Ferryman was not drunk or poisoned when they died), that player becomes alive. Mark CROSSING.

jinxes.reason: An Outsider converted by the Siren is evil and cannot be resurrected by the Ferryman.

If the Wrecker's ability is working and both the dead Ferryman and the chosen other dead player are Wrecked, the Wrecker redirects a good Ferryman's night choice to the Ferryman themself. The original choice can be good or evil, but must be another dead player. This never permits a direct self-choice or a choice when nobody else is dead, and day choices are not redirected. The Ferryman is resurrected only if good and not drunk or poisoned when they died.

name: Stowaway
ability: Abilities that count or measure seats treat your seat as empty.
flavor: There is no such person on the manifest.

name: Albatross
ability: If you are executed, the player who nominated you dies tonight.
flavor: It followed the ship for nine days. On the tenth, someone got clever.

name: Wrecker
ability: Each night, choose 2 players: tonight, if a good player's ability would choose either of them, it chooses the other instead.
flavor: A lantern on the wrong headland has drowned more sailors than any storm.
firstNightReminder: The Wrecker points to 2 players. Mark both WRECKED. For the rest of the night, if a good player's ability chooses a WRECKED player, resolve it on the other WRECKED player instead (only if that is a legal target). Never tell the good player.
otherNightReminder: The Wrecker points to 2 players. Mark both WRECKED. For the rest of the night, if a good player's ability chooses a WRECKED player, resolve it on the other WRECKED player instead (only if that is a legal target). Never tell the good player.

name: Smuggler
ability: Each night, choose a player: you learn what they learned tonight.
flavor: Everything that comes into this port comes through me first.
firstNightReminder: The Smuggler points to a player. Show the Smuggler exactly what that player was shown tonight (fingers, character tokens, a nod or a shake), or shake your head if they learned nothing.
otherNightReminder: The Smuggler points to a player. Show the Smuggler exactly what that player was shown tonight (fingers, character tokens, a nod or a shake), or shake your head if they learned nothing.

name: Siren
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. The 1st time you choose an Outsider, they do not die: they become evil instead, and learn who you are.
flavor: You will not remember drowning. You will only remember that she asked.
otherNightReminder: The Siren points to a player. If that player is an Outsider and SUNG is not yet out (and they are not SAFE and the harbour is not closed): mark SUNG, the Outsider becomes evil, wake them, point at the Siren, show their true character token, thumbs-down; then show the Siren a thumbs-up. Otherwise, that player dies.

jinxes.reason: A Drunk converted by the Siren is told they were the Drunk. They remain the Drunk, now evil.

name: Kraken
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. If a Minion died today, you may choose a 2nd player: they die too.
flavor: Cut off one arm and eight more come looking for whoever held the knife.
otherNightReminder: The Kraken points to a player: they die. If THRASH is out (a Minion died during the day), the Kraken may point to a 2nd player: they die too. Check SAFE for each separately. Remove THRASH.
